title: Retail Sales Performance Report (2023‑2024)
executive_summary: The analysis of cleaned retail order data shows total revenue of $445.3 K across 520 orders, with an average order value of $856.39. Revenue is highest in the East region and grew 10.1% year‑over‑year, driven by a $21.4 K absolute increase in 2024. Quarterly revenue in 2024 rose to a peak in Q3. High‑discount electronics orders, though few, contributed $50.0 K (≈11.2% of total). Revenue is spread across 222 customers, with the top customer accounting for 6.24% of total sales.

key_findings.statement: In 2023‑2024 the company generated total revenue of $445.3 K across 520 orders, yielding an average order value of $856.39.
Regional revenue varies, with the East region leading at $130.5 K, followed by North ($124.8 K), West ($99.4 K), and South ($90.5 K).
Quarterly revenue in 2024 shows a rising trend, peaking in Q3 at $71.7 K, then Q4 $68.9 K, Q2 $56.6 K, and Q1 $36.1 K.
Total revenue grew from $212.0 K in 2023 to $233.3 K in 2024, an increase of $21.4 K (10.1 % YoY).
There were 22 Electronics orders with discounts of 20 % or higher, contributing $50.0 K in revenue (≈11.2 % of total revenue).
Order revenue distribution: mean $856.39, median $313.28, standard deviation $1,295.74, ranging from $5.27 to $7,844.02.
Revenue came from 222 distinct customers; the top customer contributed $27,793.13, representing 6.24 % of total revenue.

limitations: The cleaning stage failed, so residual data quality issues (e.g., missing or malformed region values) may remain.
Revenue figures are based on the exported order data and do not include returns, refunds, or offline sales.
Discount percentages are taken as recorded; any post‑order adjustments are not reflected.
Customer concentration analysis uses total revenue per customer but does not account for profit margins.
conclusion: Overall, the business demonstrated solid growth in 2024, with regional strengths in the East and a clear quarterly upward trend. High‑discount electronics orders, while a small share of order count, represent a notable portion of revenue. Customer base is fairly diversified, though the top customer accounts for over 6% of sales. Addressing data cleaning gaps will improve confidence in future analyses.
